# Anahita

> Open-source social software that an organisation runs for its own community: people, groups, events, articles, photos, videos, custom feeds and websites, in a chronological feed with no tracking. It speaks ActivityPub (the fediverse) and the AT Protocol (Bluesky). Federation is opt-in for each profile.

Anahita is made for schools, newsrooms, libraries, research groups and non-profits leaving mainstream platforms. It is two codebases: anahita-services, Go services behind one API (OpenAPI 3.1), run with Docker Compose locally and Kubernetes live; and anahita-web, the React and Material UI web app. Maintained and developed by rmd Studio.

## Docs

- [Docs](https://www.anahita.io/docs/): where every part of the documentation lives
- [anahita-web docs](https://github.com/anahitasocial/anahita-web/tree/main/docs): getting started, configuration, customising, architecture
